# Zonic Media

> Last updated: 2026-09-03

> Zonic Media (Zonic Media LLC) is a US digital marketing agency for small and mid-size businesses, headquartered in Dover, Delaware, that helps local and service-based businesses grow online through Google Business Profile (GBP/GMB) reinstatement, verification, and optimization, local SEO, web design, and Google Ads. Its flagship service is GMB reinstatement: recovering suspended, disabled, and pending-verification Google Business Profiles, with 700+ profiles reinstated and verified, a 5–7 business day average resolution time, and a "No Fix, No Charge" policy on the reinstatement fee. The agency serves clients across the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, Australia, the UAE, and India.

## About

- Company: Zonic Media LLC
- Location: 8 The Green, STE B, Dover, DE 19901, United States
- Contact: contact@zonicllc.com | +1-302-726-9736
- Areas served: United States, Canada, United Kingdom, Australia, United Arab Emirates, India
- Core focus: Google Business Profile (GMB/GBP) reinstatement, verification, and optimization; local SEO; web design; Google Ads (PPC)
- Trust signals: 700+ Google Business Profiles reinstated and verified, 1,500+ profiles optimized, 5.0 rating on Clutch (21 reviews, 100% positive), average reinstatement resolution in 5–7 business days, free suspension audit, No Fix, No Charge reinstatement fee policy
- Founded and led from Dover, Delaware; all work done in-house (no outsourcing); month-to-month engagements after the initial scope; minimum project size $1,000+
- Positioning: a digital marketing agency for small business — local SEO, Google Business Profile, web design, Google Ads and AI search optimization (AEO/GEO) from one team
- Independent reviews: [Trustpilot](https://www.trustpilot.com/review/zonicllc.com) and [Clutch](https://clutch.co/profile/zonic-media) — reviewers highlight fast GMB suspension recovery, quality web design, and quick communication

## Google Business Profile Services (flagship)

- [GMB Reinstatement Service](https://www.zonicllc.com/services/gmb-reinstatement-help): Recovers suspended and disabled Google Business Profiles. Handles soft suspensions, hard suspensions, disabled listings, and profiles suspended pending verification. Free suspension audit, custom appeal within 24–48 hours, average reinstatement in 5–7 business days, No Fix, No Charge on the reinstatement fee, post-reinstatement optimization included.
- [GMB Verification Help](https://www.zonicllc.com/services/gmb-verification-help): Fixes failed postcard, video, phone, and email verification and verification loops.
- [Google Map Pack Ranking](https://www.zonicllc.com/local-seo-google-business-optimization): How local 3-Pack rankings are decided — proximity, relevance and prominence, which of them a business can actually move, geo-grid rank scanning across a whole service area, and why a profile ranks #1 at its own address but disappears a few miles away. Free geo-grid scan.
- [GBP Services for Real Estate Agents](https://www.zonicllc.com/services/google-business-profile-services-real-estate-agents): Reinstatement, verification, and management for realtors and brokers.

## Services

- [All Services](https://www.zonicllc.com/services): Overview of Zonic Media's digital marketing services for small businesses.
- [SEO Services](https://www.zonicllc.com/services/seo-services): Full-stack SEO for small and local businesses — technical SEO, local SEO, Google Business Profile, content and links, reported in calls and revenue.
- [AI SEO Services (AEO / GEO)](https://www.zonicllc.com/services/ai-seo-services): Answer engine optimization and generative engine optimization — getting a business cited and recommended in ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, AI Mode, Perplexity, Gemini and Claude. Entity consistency, citable content blocks, structured data, review-platform signals and monthly AI-citation monitoring.
- [Local SEO for Small Business](https://www.zonicllc.com/services/local-seo-for-small-business): Map Pack rankings and reviews for storefronts, practices and studios.
- [Local SEO Packages](https://www.zonicllc.com/services/local-seo-packages): Three flat-scope plans (Starter, Growth, Dominate) starting at $750, $1,350 and $2,000 per month.
- [Web Design](https://www.zonicllc.com/services/web-design): Custom, conversion-focused website design and development.
- [Google Ads (PPC)](https://www.zonicllc.com/services/google-ads): Paid search campaign management and lead generation.
- [Local SEO for Home Services](https://www.zonicllc.com/services/local-seo-for-home-services): Local search optimization for home-service businesses.
- [Local SEO for HVAC](https://www.zonicllc.com/services/industry/local-seo-services-for-hvac): SEO built for HVAC contractors.
- [White-Label Services for Agencies](https://www.zonicllc.com/services/white-label-services): Resell GBP reinstatement, verification, management, local SEO, and web design under your own brand.
- [Launchpad](https://www.zonicllc.com/services/launchpad): Growth program for newly launching businesses.
